next.reason: 1985 makes the indexed FILE STATUS clause the sequential one and points to I-O status for its content. 2023 has one FILE STATUS clause, used by the indexed file control entry, whose data item receives the I-O status: §2023:12.4.5.8.4 GR1 'A list of the possible I-O status values is contained in 9.1.13, I-O status'. No organization distinction.
